_comment: Dates only, never secrets. health.yml reads this to open a `rotation-due` issue 30 days before each expiry (docs/08 §6, docs/11 §7.3). Update it in the same PR as any rotation.

T2.name: loremfile-ci-r2
T2.note: Owner set a 6-month TTL; the date here is derived from the creation date rather than read from the dashboard. Correct it if the dashboard disagrees — a rotation reminder is only as good as its date.

T4.name: loremfile-ci-analytics
T4.note: docs/10 §4 specifies 365 days for this token; the owner set ~174. Shorter is safer, and it means all three expire together in early March 2027 — one rotation event, but also a single cliff. docs/11 §7.3 stays the procedure.

T5.name: loremfile-public
T5.note: Admin Read only; its one caller is audit_bucket_locks (docs/08 §2 step 10c). Expires about two weeks after T1 and T4, so March 2027 is two rotation dates, not one.
